dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: ~♪ The waters gleam, the fish they leap, the seafoam sings of night's deep sleep. ♪~

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: ~♪ The homesick lightly grasp at sand, the shells bear their tears to their native land. ♪~

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello there.

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Well met, lovely one!

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Call me Potier — a street artist, I am. My talents are many, and my skills, infinite!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Enjoy in silence...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What else can you do?

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: I act, I do opera, I play the lyre... I can even do some magic.

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: I am an artist, after all — I can do a little bit of everything.

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Ah, if only the day would come when I can perform at the opera house — uh, not in the sense of standing trial, though.

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Do you need a lock picked, or perhaps switched?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem a little familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, you must've seen me playing the lyre on the streets during the day.

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: "The waters gleam, the fish they leap~" Ring a bell?

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Now, I know what you're thinking. "How does this person know how to do everything?"

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Hehe, it never hurts to learn new skills, you know? Just little tricks for a little profit — and every little is a gain.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You do this business by night?

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Of course! Don't people usually realize that they've forgotten to bring their keys only upon returning home at night?

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Ah, wait, I get it — you're wondering if I'm doing something terrible here, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Don't worry, don't worry. I have principles and sense — and more importantly, I don't want to perform a "trial-standing show" at the opera house.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm fine, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: No worries. Just call me up when you need me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lovely singing!

dialogues.speaker: Potier
dialogues.text: Thank you for your support! Parting is inevitable, but may my song accompany you on this beautiful day in Fontaine.
